text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Footprints on a riverbed disappear 
quickly. Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because the water keeps flowing. Because 
it is covered over and over again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And what if it's exceptionally deep?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What if it was gouged so deep, so very 
deep, that no flow of water could ever 
cover it?

Aston Machan was already well-known among 
Trainers even before her debut.

Thanks to her talent, she even appeared on 
the nationwide TV show "New Paka," and 
attention is quickly gathering around her.

Feeling strange pressure will only hurt 
the race. Carrying a warm drink, I entered 
the waiting room to find—

After searching all over, I finally found 
Aston Machan, who had already changed and 
was waiting in the underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to step in deeply. 
However, it must be a step that leads 
naturally into the second.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Can you do it? Yes, you can, Mar-chan.

She doesn't seem to notice me at all. Nor 
does she seem to be feeling any pressure.

Showing no sign of having heard the call, 
Aston Machan runs on all alone.
